source.name: Ballpark Digest: Petco, Padres extend Petco Park naming-rights deal through 2027
source.quote: Petco Health and Wellness and the San Diego Padres are extending the Petco Park naming-rights deal for two additional years, through the 2027 MLB season.

note: Ballpark naming rights: Petco Park. The 2021 extension runs through the 2027 season; the original start of the naming-rights deal is not given, so from stays null. Value not disclosed.
